definitions.gloss: rural area; county district; area outside incorporated cities
definitions.explanation: In Japanese administrative geography, the areas of a prefecture that lie outside incorporated cities ({市|し}). These are the towns ({町|まち}) and villages ({村|むら}) organized under county ({郡|ぐん}) groupings. Often used as a contrast to {市部|しぶ} (urban areas).

examples.japanese: {郡部|ぐんぶ}の{人口|じんこう}が{減少|げんしょう}している。
examples.english: The population in rural areas is declining.

examples.japanese: {市部|しぶ}と{郡部|ぐんぶ}では{生活|せいかつ}スタイルが{大|おお}きく{異|こと}なる。
examples.english: Lifestyles differ greatly between urban and rural areas.

examples.japanese: この{県|けん}では{郡部|ぐんぶ}に{住|す}む{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}への{医療|いりょう}サービスが{課題|かだい}になっている。
examples.english: In this prefecture, medical services for elderly people living in rural areas have become a challenge.

notes:
Composed of {郡|ぐん} (county/district) + {部|ぶ} (area/section). In Japan's administrative system, prefectures are divided into {市|し} (cities) and {郡|ぐん} (counties), with the counties containing {町|まち} (towns) and {村|むら} (villages).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市部|しぶ}と{郡部|ぐんぶ}: urban and rural areas
- {郡部|ぐんぶ}の{人口|じんこう}: rural population
- {郡部|ぐんぶ}に{住|す}む: to live in a rural area
- {郡部|ぐんぶ}{出身|しゅっしん}: from a rural area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {田舎|いなか}: countryside; rural area — the everyday word, can be slightly condescending
- {地方|ちほう}: provinces; regional area — broader, means anywhere outside major cities
- {市部|しぶ}: urban area; city districts — the direct opposite of {郡部|ぐんぶ}
- {僻地|へきち}: remote area — more extreme, implies difficulty of access
